reads.note: agent tool backed by an embedded sub-workflow (workflowJson): Set domain, prefix http:// when missing, GET the URL (HTTP Request v4.2, any status but 2xx fails), then extract `a` with returnValue attribute but no attribute name; as written the split items carry `output`, not `href`, so the URL tool is expected to return nothing in n8n. The URLs the agent asks for are model-chosen; the pages likely to be asked for are served under both http and https, the same bodies under Text and URLs

writeReplies.note: Supabase create: POST /rest/v1/companies_output with Prefer: return=representation; the reply echoes the row

branches: no IF/Switch; inside the URL tool, Filter out empty hrefs and Filter out invalid URLs drop items (expected to drop all of them, see the URLs note)
